articles.title: Bitcoin surges past $80,000 as crypto rally gathers pace
articles.description: Bitcoin surged past the $80,000 mark, as renewed inflows into spot bitcoin ETFs and improving risk appetite extended the cryptocurrency's recent rally.

articles.title: Xpeng shares sink as weak delivery forecast overshadows $6.3 billion robot unit valuation
articles.description: Xpeng shares slid after weak delivery guidance, even as its nascent robotics business secured a valuation nearly matching that of its core EV business.

articles.title: BNB Chain activates Pasteur hard fork to strengthen bridge security
articles.description: BNB Chain activates the Pasteur hard fork on BSC, closing bridge and validator security gaps while targeting greater transaction capacity.

articles.title: Porsche inks $1.5 billion deal for AI deployment with India’s largest IT services firm Tata Consultancy
articles.description: Indian IT services giant TCS has secured a $1.5 billion contract to deploy AI for German sports carmaker Porsche.

articles.title: Gold hits over three-month high on dollar weakness, Treasury bond buyback plans
articles.description: Gold prices rose to its highest in over three months, supported by a weaker U.S. dollar and the U.S. treasury's recent buyback announcement

articles.title: Korean bank taps Ripple for payments, Pakistan opens crypto licensing: Asia Express
articles.description: Asia’s biggest crypto hubs are locked in a tax-cut arms race, while Ripple will help Korea’s Jeonbuk Bank move money across borders.

articles.title: Bitcoin hits $80,000 for the first time since May as crypto recovery accelerates
articles.description: BTC has now surged 38% following its June plunge as shifting U.S. Treasury policy helped bring buyers back to crypto, rejuvenating ETF demand.

articles.title: Paramount CEO David Ellison is at the final hurdle before buying WBD. So far, he can't clear it
articles.description: An antitrust challenge by a group of state attorneys general has left Paramount CEO David Ellison hunting for avenues to get his deal for WBD done.

articles.title: Main Street Sports sues Comcast, Charter for underpaid licensing fees
articles.description: Main Street has been in the process of winding down its portfolio of regional sports networks since the the NHL and NBA seasons ended earlier this year.

articles.title: Trump says U.S. will hike Canada auto tariffs to 50% as trade war escalates
articles.description: President Donald Trump said the U.S. will raise tariffs on imports of cars, trucks and auto parts from Canada to 50% on Jan. 1, 2027.

articles.title: Mark Walter's TWG Global hires Goldman veteran Markowitz as top lawyer amid probe of insurers
articles.description: Federal authorities are investigating how two insurers that are part of Mark Walter's business empire classified more than $20 billion in loans to his companies.

articles.title: CNBC's The China Connection newsletter: Robots need help learning human skills. These AI companies are rushing to meet the demand
articles.description: Humanoid robots still take a long time to complete human tasks. Several startups in China are trying different ways to collect and use training data better.

articles.title: Los Angeles Lakers worth 'every bit' of $12.5 billion price tag: 76ers and Commanders owner Josh Harris
articles.description: The Los Angeles Lakers set a new record for a professional team sale price at $12.5 billion, and sports investor Josh Harris said the team is worth "every bit."

articles.title: A media M&A chill: The Paramount-WBD antitrust challenge may hold up more deals than one
articles.description: Paramount's proposed merger with WBD is delayed while an antitrust lawsuit plays out. The holdup could mean a freeze across the media industry.

articles.title: California AG Rob Bonta cancels Paramount settlement meeting, citing 'lack of good faith'
articles.description: California AG Rob Bonta was scheduled to meet with Paramount representatives on Monday, he said, but canceled the meeting.

articles.title: Hugging Face Explores $13 Billion Sale a Month After a Rogue OpenAI Agent Hacked It
articles.description: The open-source AI hub is fielding buyout interest at nearly triple its 2023 valuation, weeks after a security breach and days after Stripe's OpenRouter deal reset the price of AI infrastructure.

articles.title: Supreme Court allows some Trump vote-by-mail limits ahead of midterm election
articles.description: The unsigned order lifted an injunction covering 23 states and Washington, D.C.; the court’s three liberal justices dissented.

articles.title: CFTC, US soldier accused of illegal Polymarket bet spar over interpretation of prediction markets
articles.description: A judge stayed the CFTC’s civil case against a soldier who allegedly used nonpublic information for a Polymarket bet, but the regulator is trying to weigh in on the criminal case.

articles.title: Strive Buys $81.5 Million in Bitcoin After Issuing More Shares
articles.description: The company increased its Bitcoin holdings by 5.5%, but its Bitcoin per fully diluted share rose only about 1.4%.

articles.title: Trump’s oil and gas stocks gained up to $15.5 million amid Iran war, congressional Democrats say
articles.description: Trump’s stock trading could face heightened congressional scrutiny if Democrats retake either chamber in the midterms.
